name: Adyntel
summary: Competitor ad intelligence: the ads a company runs on Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok, keyword search across ad libraries, and a domain's paid and organic keywords.

api_key.description: your Adyntel API key (adyntel.com profile > Integrations)

email.description: the email of your Adyntel account; sent with every call

notes: Every endpoint is a POST, and the API key and account email go in the JSON body beside the call's own fields, as Adyntel's examples show; the router adds both.
Credits: roughly one per page (about 30 ads); a 204 (no ads found) is not charged. 401 means bad credentials, 402 not enough credits.
Pagination (all but meta.keyword_search): send the previous answer's continuation_token back with the same other fields. The last page returns a null token.
all_ads and webhook_url are left out of this catalog: they push results to another URL and can burn many credits.

endpoints.name: List a company's Meta ads
endpoints.summary: Ads a company runs on Facebook and Instagram.

facebook_url.description: Facebook page URL starting https://. Give this or company_domain.

company_domain.description: company.com, without https:// or www.. Give this or facebook_url.

country_code.description: One ISO country code, or ALL. (Arrays need the webhook mode left out here.)

active_status.description: inactive or all; default active only.

ad_type.description: political, properties, employment or financial. political works for the US only.

check_ugc.description: Adds is_ugc_video to video ads; needs media_type video.

notes: A read over POST. About 30 ads per page, one credit per page.

endpoints.name: List a company's Google ads
endpoints.summary: Search, image and video ads a company runs on Google.

country_code.description: One ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or anywhere. Resend it with every continuation_token.

notes: A read over POST. One credit per page.

endpoints.name: List a company's LinkedIn ads
endpoints.summary: Ads a company runs on LinkedIn.

linkedin_page_id.description: LinkedIn Page id. Give this or company_domain.

date_filter.description: Preset string (last30d, month, year, lastyear) or {startdate, enddate}; ranges stay within 364 days.

impression_data.description: Adds EU transparency data per ad (+1 credit). Cannot combine with date_filter.

extract_text.description: Adds text read from the creative (+1 credit).

notes: A read over POST. One credit per page; impression_data and extract_text each add one.

endpoints.name: Search LinkedIn ads by keyword
endpoints.summary: LinkedIn Ad Library ads matching a keyword.

dateOption.description: current-month, current-year, custom-date-range, last-30-days or last-year.

notes: A read over POST. Stop when is_last_page is true.

endpoints.name: Search Meta ads by keyword

country_code.description: Limit to one country, e.g. US.

notes: A read over POST. The answer has continuation_token and is_result_complete, but this endpoint documents no way to send the token back for more.

endpoints.name: List a brand's TikTok ads
endpoints.summary: TikTok ads run by a brand, optionally with influencers posting sponsored content for it.

company_domain.description: The brand's own domain; tiktok.com is rejected.

influencer_ads.description: Also return influencers posting sponsored content (+1 credit).

continuation_tokens.description: The continuation_tokens object from the previous answer.

notes: A read over POST. 204 with an empty body means the company runs no TikTok ads.

endpoints.name: Search TikTok ads by keyword

country_code.description: One country (mostly European codes) or ALL. US cannot be used as a filter.

notes: A read over POST. The answer has has_more, search_id and total; the docs do not say how to fetch more.

endpoints.name: Get one TikTok ad
endpoints.summary: Full details of a TikTok ad by id.

id.description: TikTok ad id from a TikTok search answer.

endpoints.name: Get a domain's paid and organic keywords
endpoints.summary: Summary of a domain's paid and organic keywords, with estimated budget and CPC.

language.description: Language of keyword results; default English.

notes: A read over POST. limit defaults to 1: raise it.
